title: Launch HN: Hebbian Robotics (YC S26) – Build scalable robotics data pipelines
summary: Hebbian Robotics launched HFlow, an SDK that transforms messy multimodal recordings from robots and human operators into standardized, quality-checked episodes with queryable dataset manifests. The tool processes synchronized streams including video, joint states, actions, timestamps, and metadata to create training-ready data pipelines for robotics ML.
problem_solved: Solves the data preprocessing bottleneck in robotics ML by automating the conversion of raw heterogeneous sensor recordings into clean, standardized, queryable datasets.
why_valuable: It accelerates robotics ML development by eliminating the tedious work of manual data cleaning and standardization, enabling researchers and engineers to focus on model training rather than data wrangling.
